label_semantics: preparation pulse amplitude 0 versus 1; not verified true qubit state
split_semantics: ordered recorded shot indices; no asserted cross-preparation wall-clock interleave
binning: mean within numpy.array_split of all 781 original sample indices; no fitted time window
training_information: Every method has access to the same 128 reference and 64 calibration labelled shots per preparation. Pooled baselines fit all 192. Affine method freezes the reference boxcar and fits its transform from only the calibration block.
affine_method: unchanged least-squares two-dimensional IQ matrix and offset formula; empirical reference templates replace synthetic nominal templates; new measured coefficients
selection: maximum validation balanced accuracy; ties choose listed baseline_methods order; no hyperparameter search

utility_acceptance.interpretation: preregistered engineering feasibility threshold, not a physical-qubit fidelity claim

calibration_acceptance.interpretation: diagnostic within-acquisition gain only; no drift-transfer success can be declared

integer_export.scale_rule: max absolute pooled training sample maps to normalized magnitude 4
integer_export.weight_rule: divide boxcar weights and bias by largest absolute weight

scientific_rerun_policy: one final evaluation; preserve failure; no tuning on final; fresh output directory required
